theorems.statement: ∀ {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ] (A B : Set X) (h : X → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → X → ℝ≥0∞) (G : X → ℝ≥0∞) (k : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (κ L : ℝ≥0∞) (ε : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → Measurable h → Measurable (Function.uncurry φ) → Measurable G → Measurable (Function.uncurry k) → (∀ x ∈ B, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, φ t x ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ B, ∫⁻ ζ in A, k x ζ ∂μ ≤ L) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ᵐ ζ ∂μ, ζ ∈ A → t + ε < h ζ → κ ≤ ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x * k x ζ ∂μ) → κ * ∫⁻ ζ in A, ENNReal.ofReal (h ζ - ε) ∂μ ≤ L * ∫⁻ x in B, G x ∂μ
